title: Port the prototype playbook as a standalone skill
action: Turn pstack's prototype playbook into a standalone skill here. The source is at /tmp/claude-1000/-home-thanhsmind-Projects-goglbe-beehive/9d0933f3-e76c-498c-a471-1b5f7f684697/scratchpad/pstack-src/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/prototype.md — read it in full first. Write .claude/skills/prototype/SKILL.md with frontmatter carrying name prototype, a description that triggers on 'prototype this', 'try a few options', 'which layout', and disable-model-invocation true (per D6). Keep the whole idea intact: planning by code, speed over polish, the design decision is the deliverable and the code is throwaway. Keep all six steps — scope the decision, gather references when the space is open, build throwaway in an isolated scratch directory, put alternatives behind one switcher, verify on the matching surface, present alternatives with a recommendation. Apply the adaptation contract in the plan's Approach section. Rewire three things. The scratch directory is the session scratchpad directory named in the session environment, never a bare /tmp path. The control skill for driving a surface is this repo's own: read .claude/skills/verify-app/SKILL.md and cite it plus its control-bee helper by real path, instead of pstack's control-ui or control-cli from cursor-team-kit. The handoff at the end goes to bee-planning for the real build (per D2 — bee-planning owns plan shape here, pstack's Feature and multi-phase-plan playbooks are not ported), and to the architect skill when the open question is the shape rather than the behavior. Where the source cites the exhaust-the-design-space principle skill, that skill is not ported: run `ls .claude/skills/ | grep bee-principle` and cite the matching bee principle if one fits, otherwise say the idea in one plain clause. Add the provenance line naming cursor/plugins pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/prototype.md as the source. Write to .claude/skills/ only (per D7).
verify: python3 -c "import sys;p='.claude/skills/prototype/SKILL.md';s=open(p).read();sys.exit('missing frontmatter flag') if 'disable-model-invocation: true' not in s else 0" && rg -q 'verify-app' .claude/skills/prototype/SKILL.md && ! rg -n 'cursor-team-kit|pstack/skills/|poteto-agent|generalPurpose|~/\.cursor|grok-4|claude-fable-5-1-thinking|subagent_type' .claude/skills/prototype

The surface-driving step cites this repo's verify-app skill by real path
